copy.rewarded-hint-room-7: There is a way to make your clicks add selections instead of replacing them.

copy.rewarded-hint-room-10: The character is not the only thing in that forest that can move.

copy.no-hay-una-sala-anterior-todavia: There is no previous room. Yet.

copy.esta-ya-la-conoces-no-hace-falta-vo: You know this one already. No need to solve it again.
copy.no-hace-falta-seguir-retrocediendo: There is no need to keep going back.

copy.otra-vez-esta-tecla-si-ya-la-soltas: This key again. Yes, you released it. I registered that. Now let us move forward.

copy.no-no-sigas-retrocediendo-segui-hac: No. Stop going backward. Keep moving forward. That is the direction we were already going.
copy.otra-vez-shift-tab-no-hace-falta-se: Shift+Tab again? There is no need. Keep moving forward, please.
copy.shift-tab-otra-vez-ya-vi-que-sabes-: Shift+Tab. Again. I know you can press it. Now stop and keep going.
copy.shift-tab-shift-tab-es-lo-unico-que: Shift+Tab, Shift+Tab. Is that the only thing you know how to do? It is starting to look that way.

copy.shift-tab-deja-de-volver-te-lo-esto: Shift+Tab! Stop going back. I am serious.
copy.no-me-estas-escuchando-deja-de-retr: You are not listening. Stop going backward. Now.
copy.que-queres-encontrar-no-hay-nada-no: What are you looking for? There is nothing. Nothing. Go back.
copy.para-no-sigas-por-favor-segui-hacia: Stop! Do not keep going. Please, move forward.
copy.no-no-no-llegaste-al-principio-ya-e: No, no, no. You reached the beginning. That is it. There is nothing before it. Stop pressing Shift+Tab. Please.
copy.esperabas-que-empezara-solo-presion: Were you waiting for it to start by itself? Press Shift. We can pretend it was your idea.
copy.ja-volviste-no-encontraste-la-opcio: HA! You came back. You still missed the secret option. It really was quite simple. Now you get to solve all fourteen rooms again. From scratch.
copy.el-operador-perdio-el-control-encon: The Operator lost control. You found the exit.
copy.el-barco-esta-a-salvo-el-operador-n: The ship is safe. The Operator does not know who answered.
copy.otra-vez-vos-la-primera-vez-todavia: You again. The first time, the run had not even started yet.
copy.ves-todo-sigue-bajo-control-incluso: See? Everything is still under control. Even you.
copy.si-sabemos-que-ese-es-el-shift-pens: Yes, we know that is the Shift key. Do you plan to do anything with it?
copy.shift-tab-no-hace-falta-aca-las-fle: No need for Shift+Tab here. The arrow keys will do.
copy.esta-bien-la-sesion-sigue-abierta: All right. The session remains open.
copy.bien-por-un-momento-pense-que-ibas-: Good. For a moment, I thought you were about to make a sensible decision.
copy.indice-cerrado-el-recorrido-sigue-e: Index closed. The run is exactly where you left it.
copy.y-si-todo-es-con-shift-aca-hasta-pa: ...And yes, everything here uses Shift. Even finding this option. I do not know why I am surprised.
copy.el-panel-responde-no-veo-por-que-se: The panel works. I do not see why you keep testing it.
copy.no-hace-falta-cerrar-la-sesion-pode:

ENTER confirms. ESC cancels.
copy.indice-completo-enter-o-esc-para-ce: Full index. Press Enter or Esc to close.
copy.estas-seguro-se-borrara-todo-el-pro:

ENTER to confirm. ESC to cancel.
copy.no-tenes-permisos-para-estar-aca-au: You are not allowed in here. Although… S.O.S. is not the only Morse code that works here. ESC to leave.
copy.seguis-insistiendo-a-ver-si-esta-te: Still insisting. Maybe this will help: what other three-letter word could help you WIN this game? ESC to leave.

copy.pudiste-apagarlo-no-era-la-idea: You managed to shut it down! That wasn't quite the idea: there were fourteen whole rooms to beat. But sure, turning things off counts as progress, I suppose.
copy.completion-under-30-seconds: Thirty seconds? Did you come prepared, or find Shift by accident?
copy.completion-under-one-minute: Under a minute. I hope you at least read the instructions.
copy.completion-under-five-minutes: A reasonable time. Do not get used to me complimenting you.
copy.completion-under-ten-minutes: Five minutes. The Operator appreciates that it was not fourteen rooms this time.
copy.completion-under-twenty-minutes: Quite a while. Were you solving rooms or admiring the menu?
copy.completion-over-twenty-minutes: Over twenty minutes. I'm requesting time off. Not because of work: because of you.
copy.press-enter-to-restart: PRESS ENTER TO RETURN TO THE TITLE.
copy.ya-te-dije-que-no-tenes-permisos-no: I told you that you are not allowed in here. Do not try again. I mean it: I do not want to see you here again. ESC to leave.
copy.no-tenes-permisos-para-estar-aca-es: You are not allowed in here. I hope you will not come bother me again. ESC to leave.
copy.bien-apretar-shift-funcionaba-de-na: There. Pressing Shift worked. You are welcome for the added difficulty.
copy.no-hay-un-solo-shift: There is more than one Shift key…
copy.la-puerta-cedio-no-te-acostumbres-n: The door gave way. Do not get used to it; doing the same thing twice rarely works.
copy.bien-era-una-tecla-dibujada-el-dibu: There. It was a drawing of a key. The drawing was doing its best.
copy.que-suerte-aca-esta-caps-lock-la-te: Lucky you: there is Caps Lock. The perfect key for typing EVERYTHING LIKE YOU ARE ANGRY.
copy.bien-no-todas-las-mayusculas-son-ig: There. Not all uppercase letters are the same.
copy.la-palabra-es-la-correcta-pero-caps: The word is right. But Caps Lock does not do the same job as holding down another key.
copy.la-palabra-parece-correcta-pero-esa: The word looks right. But those uppercase letters still are not quite right.
copy.veo-que-todavia-no-estamos-entendie: I see we still have not understood what this is about…
copy.vacio-tecnicamente-una-respuesta-no: Empty. Technically an answer; just not the one we wanted.
copy.quiza-la-clave-tenga-algo-que-ver-c: Maybe the password has something to do with the idea behind this whole game. No need to invent a new word.
copy.no-esa-palabra-parece-haber-llegado: No. That word seems to have wandered into this room by accident.
copy.la-cerradura-pide-tres-caracteres-q: The lock wants three characters. Reassuring: at least they look like numbers.
copy.no-eran-numeros-eran-las-mismas-tec: Those were not numbers. They were the same keys with a different output.
copy.la-cerradura-no-quiere-los-nombres-: The lock does not want the names of the keys. It wants what they produce when you modify them.
copy.codigo-incorrecto-las-teclas-parece: Incorrect code. The keys seem very sure of themselves.
copy.estas-probando-teclas-el-reloj-agra: Testing the keys? The clock appreciates you confirming it works.
copy.esa-fue-distinta-la-espera-no: That one was different. The wait was not.
copy.el-reloj-sigue-corriendo-vos-estas-: The clock is still ticking. You are doing an excellent job interrupting it.
copy.cada-tecla-que-tocas-reinicia-la-es: Every key you press resets the timer. In case you wanted a less subtle explanation.
copy.ahora-si-no-toques-nada-nada-de-nad: Now: do not touch anything. Not a thing.
copy.y-ahi-esta-esperar-era-todo-el-plan: There it is. Waiting was the whole plan. Yes, I expected something more exciting too.
copy.mira-vos-al-final-habia-lugar-para-: Look at that. Turns out there was room for everyone.
copy.ah-esta-vez-guardaste-lo-anterior: Ah. This time you kept what you had already selected.
copy.veo-que-cambiaste-de-opinion: I see you changed your mind.
copy.lo-lograste-encontraste-el-camino-d: You did it: you found the way back. Whenever you are ready, we can continue.
copy.el-camino-hasta-aca-parece-bastante: The path here seems very committed to going one way.
copy.no-iba-a-ser-tan-sencillo-esta-vez-: It was never going to be that easy. The idea is to go back, not keep moving forward. Sometimes the way out is the way you came in.
copy.retroceso-un-metodo-bastante-litera: Backspace. A rather literal method. But it is not the only way back.
copy.insistir-con-retroceso-no-va-a-camb: Insisting on Backspace will not change the direction of the run.
copy.tab-suele-avanzar-entre-opciones-no: Tab usually moves forward through options. Moving forward is not always what you need.
copy.tab-solo-no-alcanza-para-volver-por: Tab alone is not enough to go back. Luckily, the keyboard accepts company.
copy.shift-puede-cambiar-el-sentido-de-t: The exit is not farther ahead: you have to go back. Can you think of a way to retrace your steps? I did not tell you anything.
copy.volviste-sabia-que-en-algun-momento: You came back. I knew you would want to revisit your decisions eventually.
copy.un-personaje-un-bosque-falta-apenas: A person, a forest. All that is missing is a direction.
copy.necesitas-encontrar-la-casa-seguir-: You need to find the house. Walking past the same trees does not seem to be helping.
copy.llegaste-la-casa-estaba-en-el-mapa-: You made it. The house was on the map. You only had to find it.
copy.ah-cambiaste-el-paisaje-no-el-desti: Ah. You changed the scenery, not the destination.
copy.que-familiar-esta-vez-el-dibujo-esp: How familiar. This time the drawing is waiting for you to click it.
copy.shift-en-serio-esta-vez-hasta-el-di: Shift? Really? Even the drawing was pointing at what to do this time.
copy.tab-no-esta-sala-ya-tiene-suficient: Not Tab. This room already has enough keys with identity issues.
copy.ah-cierto-era-un-boton-bien-visto-c: Oh, right! It was a button. Good eye… once you finally used it.
copy.esta-sala-no-vio-el-principio-de-la: This room did not see the action begin.
copy.te-dije-que-soltaras-no-que-presion: I said release it. Not press and release it. There is a difference, subtle as it may be.
copy.la-tecla-se-libero-pero-esta-sala-n: The key was released. But this room did not see when it all began.
copy.ahi-esta-esta-vez-entraste-con-algo: There it is. This time you entered with something still held down.
copy.ah-trabajo-en-equipo-los-dos-shifts: Teamwork. The two Shift keys finally found something in common.
copy.recibido-el-barco-esta-a-salvo-la-t: Received. The ship is safe. The crew is still not contributing much.
copy.nos-estamos-hundiendo-necesitamos-a: We are sinking. We need help.
copy.la-nave-recibio-nueve-pulsos-no-tod: The ship received nine pulses. They did not all transmit the same thing.
copy.podes-mantener-shift-para-una-raya-: Hold Shift for a dash, or release it and leave a longer pause.
copy.una-senal-se-distingue-por-su-ritmo: A signal is recognized by its rhythm, not just the number of pulses.
copy.llegaste-al-final-felicitaciones-ah: You reached the end. Congratulations. Now we can stay here forever.
copy.no-paso-nada-recorda-que-el-teclado:
Nothing happened. Remember, the keyboard has more than one direction.
I am not going to list them.
copy.sigue-sin-pasar-nada-espero-que-no-: Still nothing. I hope it does not occur to you to go back; that would be a very predictable way out.
copy.ah-volviste-esta-vez-mira-bien-las-: You came back. Look carefully at the options this time. It is not as if the exit was hard to find.
copy.primera-sala-otra-vez-apreta-shift-: First room. Again. Press Shift; at least you figured that part out last time.
copy.bien-avanzaste-una-sala-menos-para-: Good, you moved on. One less room to repeat. Thirteen to go. I do not have to count, but I will.
copy.dos-shifts-de-nuevo-ya-sabes-que-no: Two Shifts, again. You know pressing the same one is not enough. What a relief to explain it all over again.
copy.el-otro-shift-si-el-otro-esta-vez-v: The other Shift. Yes, the other one. You are faster this time. Almost as if you learned something.
copy.un-shift-dibujado-la-ultima-vez-tam: A drawn Shift key. It was a drawing last time too. Let us see how long it takes you to tell it from a real key.
copy.bien-apretaste-shift-de-nuevo-esper: Good! You pressed Shift again. I hope I did not confuse you this time.
copy.la-contrasena-sigue-siendo-shift-es: The password is still SHIFT, typed with Shift. Caps Lock does not become a solution just because you keep trying.
copy.exacto-mantener-shift-mientras-escr: Exactly: hold Shift while typing. You knew the trick already. Forgetting it would have been the surprise.
copy.la-cerradura-muestra-134-ya-sabes-q: The lock shows 134. You know Shift makes the keys produce something else. Try to remember that this time.
copy.abrio-no-hace-falta-que-parezcas-so: It opened! No need to look surprised; you have been here before.
copy.hay-que-esperar-no-toques-nada-si-o: Wait. Do not touch anything. Yes, again. Let us see if a simple instruction can last seven seconds this time.
copy.lo-lograste-esperaste-record-person: You did it: you waited. Personal best, I suppose.
copy.selecciona-todos-los-cuadrados-usan: Select every square using Shift to keep what you already selected. You have done this before. It should not be news.
copy.todos-seleccionados-excelente-la-me: All selected. Excellent. Your muscle memory survived the restart.
copy.esta-sala-vuelve-a-pedir-shift-tab-: This room wants Shift+Tab again. Curious that one combination works here, but did not help you find the secret option.
copy.volviste-por-lo-menos-esta-vez-sabi: You came back. At least this time you knew which combination to try.
copy.alterna-entre-shift-izquierdo-y-der: Alternate between left and right Shift. Yes, both of them. Coordination is not optional on a second run.
copy.los-dos-shifts-alternados-una-vez-m: Both Shift keys, alternating. Once again, exactly as before.
copy.movete-con-las-flechas-y-usa-shift-: Move with the arrow keys and use Shift with them to move the map. The house will not find itself this time either.
copy.la-casa-esta-ahi-ya-sabes-como-lleg: The house is right there. You know how to reach it; it would be strange if the forest beat you twice.
copy.es-un-boton-dibujado-se-activa-con-: It is a drawn button. Click it; do not press Shift. A distinction you have had the chance to learn already.
copy.un-clic-eso-era-todo-no-te-preocupe: One click. That was all. Do not worry, I will not pretend it was difficult.
copy.la-sala-necesita-que-entres-con-shi: Enter the room holding Shift, then release it. The second part is usually the difficult one.
copy.lo-soltaste-bien-ahora-intenta-no-r: You released it. Good. Now try not to restart the run just to find the exit.
copy.sos-tres-puntos-tres-rayas-tres-pun: SOS: three dots, three dashes, three dots. Hold Shift for each dash, or tap and leave longer pauses. You solved it once already.
copy.la-senal-llego-que-bueno-que-al-men: The signal got through. Good to know at least one thing in this run felt familiar.
copy.de-nuevo-en-el-final-la-opcion-secr: Back at the end. The secret option is still in Control. Maybe look a little closer this time.
copy.sigue-sin-pasar-nada-no-hace-falta-: Still nothing. No need to try Shift again. I hope you do not decide to go back; that would be terribly unoriginal.
copy.ah-otra-vez-aca-todo-el-recorrido-d: Back here again. The whole run, all over, and you still missed the secret option. We can repeat it; this works out perfectly for me.
copy.y-si-todo-es-con-shift-aca-hasta-pa: ...And yes, everything here uses Shift. Even finding this option. It took you another full run, but you made it.
copy.otra-vez-el-barco-ya-lo-salvaste-de: The ship again. You saved it after solving all fourteen rooms again. And still you missed the secret option.
copy.otra-vez-soltando-shift-despues-de-: Releasing Shift again. After that whole run, you are starting the way back. The secret option is still simple.
copy.otra-vez-el-clic-que-dedicacion-par: Another click. Such dedication to repeat everything and end up in exactly the same place.
copy.ya-conoces-este-camino-lo-recorrist: You know this path. You just walked all of it. And now you are back, knowing how it ends.
copy.los-dos-shifts-otra-vez-todo-otra-v: Both Shifts again. Everything again. Somehow, the secret option is still eluding you.
copy.otra-vez-shift-tab-al-menos-esta-co: Shift+Tab again. At least you found this combination. Shame it was not the other one.
copy.los-cuadrados-de-nuevo-despues-de-r: The squares again. After repeating fourteen rooms, starting over is beginning to look like a habit.
copy.esperaste-siete-segundos-para-volve: You waited seven seconds just to repeat the whole run. No need to explain the plan; I am already enjoying it.
copy.la-cerradura-otra-vez-si-seguis-el-: The lock again. Keep following the cycle and you will end up here. Then Control. Then… well, you know.
copy.escribi-shift-de-nuevo-ojala-la-opc: Type SHIFT again. If only the secret option were as easy to read. Oh, right: it is.
copy.el-dibujo-otra-vez-todo-el-recorrid: The drawing again. The whole run again. And the secret exit is still unfound.
copy.la-puerta-se-abre-vos-volves-y-yo-n: The door opens, you come back, and I do not have to do a thing. It is a very efficient system.
copy.y-de-nuevo-al-comienzo-repetiste-to: And back to the beginning. You repeated the whole game just to return here without finding the exit. Shall we continue? I can do this forever.
copy.y-si-todo-es-con-shift-aca: ...Y sí, todo es con Shift acá.
